note: All prices are subject to applicable taxes. Menu details and availability may change.

items.name: Butter Chicken Poutine
items.description: Crispy golden fries layered with tender butter chicken in a rich tomato-cream sauce and finished with melting cheese curds. Our most-ordered starter, made for sharing.

items.name: Chicken Quesadilla
items.description: Griddled flour tortilla filled with seasoned grilled chicken, sauteed red and green peppers, red onion and a three-cheese melt. Served with house salsa and sour cream.

items.name: Nashville Chicken Sliders
items.description: Three soft slider buns stacked with crispy Nashville hot chicken, cool slaw, sliced pickles and our house special sauce. Spicy, crunchy and built to share.

items.name: Crispy Steak Bites
items.description: Bite-size steak morsels marinated in Kerala spices and flash-fried until crisp at the edges. Served with a lemon-garlic dip.

items.name: Coconut Shrimp
items.description: Plump shrimp coated in golden coconut crumbs and fried crisp. Served with sweet chilli sauce for dipping.

items.name: Garlic Butter Shrimp
items.description: Juicy shrimp sauteed in garlic butter with fresh herbs and a squeeze of lemon. Served with toasted bread to soak up the sauce.

items.name: Bruschetta
items.description: Your choice of grilled flatbread or toasted baguette topped with marinated tomatoes, mixed cheeses, creamy goat cheese and fresh mozzarella, finished with balsamic glaze. Light, fresh and made for the table.

items.name: Tempura Shrimp
items.description: Light, crisp tempura-battered shrimp fried golden. Served with cocktail sauce and sweet chilli sauce.

items.name: Début Special Platter
items.description: The full spread: crispy jalapeno poppers, beer-battered onion rings, saucy chicken wings and breaded chicken fingers. Served with an assortment of house dips.

items.name: Warm Spinach Dip
items.description: Creamy baked spinach dip blended with feta and cheddar, served bubbling hot with toasted naan points. Rich, cheesy and made for scooping.

items.name: Chicken Wings
items.description: A full pound of breaded wings tossed in your choice of honey garlic, BBQ, garlic parmesan, buffalo or hot sauce. Served with ranch and celery sticks.

items.name: Drums of Heaven
items.description: Four marinated frenched chicken drumettes fried crisp and glazed, served over golden French fries. Sticky, crunchy finger food.

items.name: Spicy Mussels
items.description: Fresh mussels steamed with minced garlic, basil oil, crushed chilli flakes, jalapeno and burst cherry tomatoes. Served with grilled bread for the flavourful broth.

items.name: Florentine Mussels
items.description: Fresh mussels simmered in a creamy garlic sauce with wilted spinach and basil oil. Mellow and rich, served with grilled bread.

items.name: Caesar Salad Bowl
items.description: Crisp romaine tossed in creamy Caesar dressing with smoky bacon, garlic croutons and shaved parmesan. A classic, done right.

items.name: Mediterranean Salad
items.description: Crisp romaine with red onion, cherry tomatoes, cucumber, black olives and green peppers in a herbed Mediterranean dressing. Fresh and bright.

items.name: Chicken BBQ Cobb Salad
items.description: Loaded Cobb-style salad with grilled BBQ chicken, avocado, goat cheese, boiled egg, bacon, cherry tomatoes and cucumber over romaine. Served with BBQ drizzle and Italian dressing on the side.

items.name: Teriyaki Salmon Salad
items.description: Fresh grilled salmon fillet over romaine with cucumber, cherry tomatoes, mushrooms and broccoli. Finished with Italian dressing.

items.name: Burrito Bowl
items.description: Seasoned rice bowls with black beans, fresh salsa, crisp greens and creamy guacamole. Fresh, filling and fully plant-based.

items.name: Chicken Teriyaki Bowl
items.description: Grilled chicken over pineapple-herbed rice with house teriyaki sauce, garlic, basil and mixed vegetables. Sweet, savoury and satisfying.

items.name: Chilli Chicken Bowl
items.description: Crispy fried chicken tossed in a fiery soy-garlic glaze with peppers and chillies. Served over rice with cooling herbs.

items.name: Swiss and Mushroom Burger
items.description: Your choice of beef, Beyond Meat or grilled chicken with sauteed mushrooms, bacon, white onion, lettuce, pickles and melted Swiss on a toasted brioche bun. Served with fries or side salad.

items.name: Début Double Stacked Cheddar Burger
items.description: Two house patties stacked with double cheddar, homemade burger sauce, onion, lettuce, tomato and pickles on a toasted brioche bun. Our signature burger, served with fries.

items.name: Chicken Californian Sandwich
items.description: Grilled chicken breast with white onion, tomato, lettuce, pickles and spicy mayo on a toasted brioche bun. Served with fries or side salad.

items.name: Chicken Bacon Club
items.description: Grilled chicken, crisp romaine, tomato, smoky bacon and garlic aioli on a toasted ciabatta bun. Served with fries or side salad.

items.name: Début Veggie Wrap
items.description: Soft tortilla wrapped with shredded lettuce, slaw, roasted spinach, guacamole, goat cheese, seasoned beans and cool tzatziki. Served with fries.

items.name: Tacos
items.description: Three corn tortillas with shredded lettuce, slaw and fresh salsa, with your choice of chicken, beef, shrimp or Beyond Meat. Served with lime and house hot sauce.

items.name: 2-piece Fish and Chips
items.description: Two pieces of crispy breaded haddock with golden fries, creamy coleslaw and house tartar sauce. A pub classic.

items.name: Quarter Chicken Leg
items.description: Tender boneless chicken leg served with fragrant herbed rice, fresh salad and a ladle of butter chicken gravy. Comforting and generous.

items.name: Teriyaki Grilled Salmon
items.description: Fresh salmon fillet grilled and glazed with teriyaki, served with roasted potatoes, broccoli and carrots. Light yet hearty.

items.name: Angus Beef Pot Roast
items.description: Slow-cooked Angus pot roast, tender and deeply savoury, served with roasted potatoes, broccoli and carrots with pan gravy.

items.name: Grilled Chicken with Mushroom Sauce
items.description: Premium grilled chicken breast with a creamy mushroom sauce, served with roasted potatoes, broccoli and carrots.

items.name: 2 Half Racks of BBQ Spare Ribs
items.description: Two half racks of pork spare ribs brushed with house BBQ sauce, served with roasted potatoes, broccoli, carrots and coleslaw. Made for big appetites.

items.name: New York Steak with Mushroom Sauce
items.description: Prime 9.5 oz New York steak cooked to your preference with a creamy mushroom sauce. Served with roasted potatoes, broccoli and carrots.

items.name: Spicy Braised Lamb Shank
items.description: Slow-braised lamb shank in warming spices until falling off the bone, served with basmati rice and seasonal roasted vegetables. Weekends or by preorder only.

items.name: Chicken 65
items.description: South Indian-style fried chicken tossed with curry leaves, chillies and garlic. Crisp, fiery and deeply savoury.

items.name: Chicken Al Farm
items.description: Chicken thigh marinated in spices, lemon and curry leaves, then fried golden. Served with naan or house salad.

items.name: Tikka Wrap
items.description: Spiced chicken or marinated paneer with sauteed vegetables and mint yogurt sauce, wrapped in a soft tortilla. Served with fries.

items.name: Chicken Samosa
items.description: Five crisp Indian-style chicken samosas served with a rich butter chicken gravy for dipping. A guest favourite.

items.name: Veggie Pad Thai
items.description: Stir-fried rice noodles with sauteed vegetables in a savoury-sweet Thai sauce, with your choice of chicken, shrimp, beef or Beyond Meat. Topped with crushed peanuts and lime.

items.name: Butter Chicken
items.description: Tender chicken simmered in a rich, creamy North Indian tomato-butter sauce with warm spices. Served with basmati rice and naan. Mild heat, full flavour.

items.name: Shahi Paneer
items.description: Soft paneer simmered in a rich tomato-cream sauce with warm spices. Served on basmati rice with warm naan.

items.name: Momos
items.description: Eight soft Indo-Nepali dumplings with a savoury chicken or paneer filling, steamed or fried. Served with spicy chutney.

items.name: Spring Rolls
items.description: Eight golden vegetable spring rolls fried crisp. Served with sweet chilli dipping sauce.

items.name: Chow-mein Noodles
items.description: Wok-tossed egg noodles with soy and oyster sauce, mixed vegetables and your choice of chicken or paneer. Smoky and satisfying, served with garlic bread.

items.name: Fettuccine Alfredo
items.description: Fettuccine in a creamy house Alfredo sauce with mushrooms, garlic and basil oil. Served with garlic bread.

items.name: Chicken Parmesan Pasta
items.description: Fettuccine with rich marinara, crispy breaded chicken breast and melted mozzarella. Served with garlic bread.

items.name: Seafood Pasta
items.description: Fettuccine with mussels, salmon and shrimp in a marinara and white wine cream sauce. Our seafood showpiece, served with garlic bread.

items.name: Creamy Garlic Shrimp Pasta
items.description: Penne in a rich creamy garlic sauce with plump garlic-marinated shrimp. Served with garlic bread.

items.name: Tuscan Bean Soup
items.description: Hearty tomato-based soup with celery, carrots, mixed beans, zucchini and spinach. Served with garlic bread.

items.name: Broccoli Cheddar Soup
items.description: Velvety soup of broccoli, cheddar and parmesan finished with cream. Served with garlic bread.

items.name: Dumpling Soup
items.description: Clear Asian-inspired broth with soft chicken dumplings, ginger and savoury spices. Comforting and aromatic.

items.name: Protein add-on
items.description: Add grilled chicken, beef, shrimp or Beyond Meat to any salad, bowl or pasta. A simple way to make it yours.

items.name: Side add-on
items.description: Add a side salad or seasoned rice to round out your meal.

items.name: Extra add-on
items.description: Swap in sweet potato fries, crispy onion rings or a mini poutine on the side.

items.name: Included side choices
items.description: Every hand-held comes with your choice of golden fries or a fresh side salad at no extra charge.

items.name: Triple Chocolate Mousse Cake
items.description: Rich triple-layer chocolate mousse cake finished with a warm chocolate drizzle. Deeply chocolatey and made to share.

items.name: Cheesecake
items.description: Creamy baked cheesecake studded with chocolate cake pieces and finished with chocolate syrup.

items.name: Double Scoop of Ice Cream
items.description: Two generous scoops of vanilla ice cream. Simple, cold and perfect after spice.

items.name: Chocolate Cake
items.description: Classic moist chocolate cake slice finished with chocolate syrup. A crowd-pleaser.

items.name: Ras Malai
items.description: Soft milk-soaked cheese discs in sweetened, fragrant thickened milk with cardamom and pistachio. Served chilled.

items.name: Water
items.description: Chilled still, sparkling or tap water, served with lemon on request. The easy table companion.

items.name: Pop
items.description: Ice-cold Coke, Diet Coke, Coke Zero, Sprite, ginger ale or iced tea. Served over ice with lemon.

items.name: Juice
items.description: Fresh orange, pineapple, cranberry or lemonade, served chilled over ice. Ask for a single flavour or a mix.

items.name: High Roads Cab Merlot
items.description: Ontario Cabernet-Merlot with black cherry, plum and soft tannins. Smooth and food-friendly. Pours: 5 oz / 8 oz / bottle.

items.name: 19 Crimes Cab Sauvignon
items.description: South Australian Cabernet Sauvignon with dark berries, mint and a touch of oak. Bold and structured. Pours: 5 oz / 8 oz / bottle.

items.name: Kim Crawford Pinot Noir
items.description: Marlborough Pinot Noir with cherry, raspberry and soft spice. Silky and elegant. Pours: 5 oz / 8 oz / bottle.

items.name: Jacobs Creek Shiraz
items.description: South Australian Shiraz with blackberry, pepper and warm spice. Full and generous. Pours: 5 oz / 8 oz / bottle.

items.name: Casillero del Diablo Reserva Merlot
items.description: Chilean Merlot Reserva with plum, chocolate and gentle tannins. Easy-drinking and versatile. Pours: 5 oz / 8 oz / bottle.

items.name: High Roads Pinot Grigio
items.description: Ontario Pinot Grigio with green apple, citrus and white flowers. Crisp and refreshing. Pours: 5 oz / 8 oz / bottle.

items.name: Kim Crawford Sauvignon Blanc
items.description: Marlborough Sauvignon Blanc with passionfruit, grapefruit and fresh herbs. Bright and zesty. Pours: 5 oz / 8 oz / bottle.

items.name: Kim Crawford Chardonnay
items.description: Marlborough Chardonnay with stone fruit, citrus and a creamy finish. Rounded and food-friendly. Pours: 5 oz / 8 oz / bottle.

items.name: Lumina Pinot Grigio
items.description: Italian Pinot Grigio with pear, apple and a clean mineral finish. Light and easy. Pours: 5 oz / 8 oz / bottle.

items.name: Kim Crawford Rosé
items.description: Marlborough rose with strawberry, watermelon and bright acidity. Fresh and perfect chilled. Pours: 5 oz / 8 oz / bottle.

items.name: Ruffino Prosecco DOC
items.description: Italian Prosecco DOC with green apple, pear and fine bubbles. Lively and celebratory. Pours: 5 oz / 8 oz / bottle.

items.name: Début Lager
items.description: Our house blonde lager, crisp and clean with light malt sweetness. Served ice-cold in a 20 oz pint. 5.0 percent.

items.name: Line 12
items.description: Traditional German-style Helles lager, smooth and balanced with a soft malt finish. 20 oz pint. 5.0 percent.

items.name: Land Shark
items.description: Easy-drinking island-style pale lager with light citrus notes. Crisp and refreshing. 20 oz pint. 4.6 percent.

items.name: 3 Speed
items.description: Light-bodied pale lager with gentle hops and a clean finish. An easy pint. 20 oz pint. 4.2 percent.

items.name: Shaggin Wagon
items.description: Hazy IPA bursting with tropical fruit, citrus and soft bitterness. For hop lovers. 20 oz pint. 6.4 percent.

items.name: Budweiser
items.description: The classic American pale lager, crisp and highly drinkable. 20 oz pint. 5.0 percent.

items.name: Canadian (Molson)
items.description: Canada's iconic lager, smooth and balanced. Served ice-cold. 20 oz pint. 5.0 percent.

items.name: Bud Light
items.description: Light lager with fewer calories and an extra-clean finish. 20 oz pint. 4.2 percent.

items.name: Stella
items.description: Belgian-style pale lager with gentle bitterness and a refined finish. 20 oz pint. 5.0 percent.

items.name: Bottled drinks
items.description: Ask your server for today's bottle selection, including Heineken, Corona, Coors Light, Michelob Ultra and Smirnoff Ice. Served chilled. 330 ml.

items.name: 9 for 9
items.description: Pick bruschetta, warm spinach dip, Chicken 65, butter chicken poutine, chicken samosa, spicy mussels, fettuccine Alfredo, Caesar salad bowl or nachos. Weekdays 5 to 7 pm. Dine-in only.

items.name: Happy Hour
items.description: Ice-cold 16 oz pours of Debut Lager or 3 Speed at a happy price. Weekdays 12 to 3 pm and 7 to 9 pm.

items.name: Weekend Bar Special
items.description: Late-weekend bar pricing on 16 oz beer and house bar rail pours. Weekends 9 to 11 pm.

items.name: Brew & Burger Monday
items.description: Any burger with a cold beer at one special price. Mondays 4 to 6 pm. Dine-in only.

items.name: Wine Wednesday
items.description: Half price on all wine bottles by the bottle. Wednesdays 4 to 6 pm. The best night for wine lovers.

items.name: Thirsty Thursday
items.description: Our signature espresso martini at a Thursday-only price. Thursdays 4 to 6 pm.

items.name: Late Night Bites
items.description: Late-night hotdogs with a Crown pour to close out Friday night. Fridays 11 pm to 1 am.
